title: Graph comparison and compact-support projection for arbitrary-base etale maps
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $e:V\to W$ a separated etale morphism of arbitrary schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Fix a factorization $V\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{r}W$ with $j$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], $r$ proper and $rj=e$, with no quasi-compactness condition on $j$. On the ordinary unbounded small-etale derived categories put $F=Rr_*Dj_!$ and let $P_{M,K}:FM\otimes_A^LK\xrightarrow{\sim}F(M\otimes_A^Le^*K)$ be the specified proper-counit/open-tensor projection of [lem-sf-etale-ambient-adjoint-projection]. Put $S=D(e_{\Sigma!})$ for the exact sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension, lem-weil-pbc-etale-restriction-injectives], and $E=D(e^*)$, with the termwise sum/evaluation adjunction $S\dashv E$ and unit $v$. Give $E$ its canonical strong monoidal structure from derived pullback [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons], transported along the exact/left-derived comparison $Le^*\cong E$, with unit comparison $u_e:EA_W\cong A_V$ [def-pur-etale-exact-pullback-unit-composition-comparisons]. Write $\mu_{B,K}:E(B\otimes_A^LK)\xrightarrow{\sim}EB\otimes_A^LEK$ for the inverse tensor comparison. Define $\kappa_{M,K}:S(M\otimes_A^LEK)\to SM\otimes_A^LK$ to be the unique $S\dashv E$ adjunct of $\mu_{SM,K}^{-1}(v_M\otimes1)$, as in [lem-pur-unit-adjunct-tensor-action].

Here is a specified graph comparison $a:S\to F$. Form $B=Z\times_WV$ with projections $q_Z:B\to Z$ and $q:B\to V$, and graph $\sigma=(j,1):V\to B$. This is an open and closed immersion. Let $t_M:q^*M\to q_Z^*Dj_!M$ be the composite
$$q^*M\longrightarrow D\sigma_!\sigma^*q^*M\cong D\sigma_!M\cong D\sigma_!\sigma^*q_Z^*Dj_!M\longrightarrow q_Z^*Dj_!M.$$
The first arrow is the unit of $\sigma^*\dashv D\sigma_!$ on the open-and-closed piece, the last is the counit of $D\sigma_!\dashv\sigma^*$, and the middle identifications use $q\sigma=1$, $q_Z\sigma=j$ and $j^*Dj_!\cong1$. Let $u_M:M\to EF M$ be
$$M\longrightarrow Rq_*q^*M\xrightarrow{Rq_*t_M}Rq_*q_Z^*Dj_!M\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}_r^{-1}}e^*Rr_*Dj_!M,$$
where the first map is the ordinary pullback/direct-image unit and $\operatorname{Ex}_r$ is proper base change [def-kun-unbounded-exchange, lem-kun-proper-base-change-torsion-ring]. Define $a_M:SM\to FM$ as the $S\dashv E$ adjunct of $u_M$.

Then $a$ is a natural isomorphism, and, for all unbounded $M\in D(V_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D(W_{\mathrm{et}},A)$,
$$P_{M,K}^{-1}\circ a_{M\otimes_A^LEK}=(a_M\otimes1_K)\circ\kappa_{M,K}.$$
This is an equality of the specified derived morphisms, without a Noetherian, quasi-compactness, constructibility or boundedness hypothesis.

source.place: Paragraph 3: the etale projection/counit normalization; agent formulation over arbitrary schemes. Stacks more-etale.tex Tag 0GKF (lemma-f-shriek-projection), the canonical tensor map. The graph construction and its invertibility are also the source declarations compactificationEtaleComparison and isIso_compactificationEtaleComparison in WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/Etale/Derived/EtaleLowerShriekCompactification.lean:160 and EtaleLowerShriekCompactificationIso.lean:276; the tensor square is an additional claim, not an attachment to those declarations.

proof.text: Apply the existing source theorem isIso_compactificationEtaleComparison, recorded in lem-sf-etale-graph-comparison-isomorphism, to obtain the first conjunct directly. Its arbitrary-base proof supplies the graph geometry, base-change and fibre detection already present in the source.

Transport unit_map_compactificationEtaleComparison from Le* to D(e*) by naturality of the canonical comparison; this identifies the sum-unit followed by E(a) with the specified exact graph unit. Naturality of supportExactPullbackTensorIso follows by expressing it as the composite of the three natural tensor/comparison isomorphisms.

Postcompose the desired tensor square with the forward projection isomorphism. Transpose under the exact sum/evaluation adjunction. The defining Hom transpose of kappa and homEquiv naturality give (v_M tensor 1);mu_SM,K^-1;E(a_M tensor 1);E(P). Tensor naturality combines its first factors into (u_M tensor 1);mu_FM,K^-1;E(P). The graph-unit tensor lemma identifies this with u_(M tensor EK), the transpose of a_(M tensor EK). Injectivity of the Hom equivalence and cancellation of the projection isomorphism prove the second conjunct.
